## Level-Up Flow

**When offered:** Worker computes `shouldLevelUp(character)` (`worker/src/services/character.ts:159`) = `xp >= XP_THRESHOLDS[level]` and `level < 10` (thresholds: 0, 300, 900, 2700, 6500, 14000, 23000, 34000, 48000, 64000 — max level 10). Returned as `canLevelUp` from `POST /api/action` (`routes/action.ts:99`) and `POST /api/combat/resolve` (`routes/combat.ts:109`). Frontend shows a banner (`character-sheet.component.html:66`) and ability picker (`game-console.component.html:19-28`); a system message prompts it after combat.

**Trigger & endpoint:** Picking an ability in `game-console.component.ts:183` `levelUp(key)` calls `GameApiService.levelUp(sessionId, characterId, abilityChoice)` → **`POST /api/levelup`** (`worker/src/routes/levelup.ts:10`). `abilityChoice` must be one of str/dex/con/int/wis/cha; 400 if `!shouldLevelUp`.

**What changes** (`services/character.ts:133` `levelUp`):
- `level` +1
- HP gain = `roll(class hit die) + CON mod`, added to both `max_hp` and current HP (hit dice: Fighter/Ranger d10, Rogue/Cleric/Bard d8, Wizard d6)
- **+2** to the chosen ability score (not capped at 20)
- AC unchanged

**After:** `routes/levelup.ts:39-50` generates flavor text (usually fallback, bug B-03), writes a `[Level Up] …` system log row and DM history turn. Frontend (`game-console.component.ts:187-194`) calls `setCharacter`, `setCanLevelUp(false)`, shows a system message, updates campaign slot level. One level granted per call—multi-level-up XP requires calling twice.
